stories.title: Blake Corum ran for 184 yards as the Rams won a 5th straight, 26-13
stories.dek: Corum's 184 yards are the 2nd-most by any player in a game this season, and the Rams ran for a season-high 241 while Matthew Stafford threw for a season-low 140.
stories.hero_stat: 184 rushing yards, Corum's season high by 84; Rams' 241 rushing yards, a season high

stories.title: Washington held Cincinnati to 31 rushing yards, its fewest allowed all season
stories.dek: The Bengals managed 6 yards on 6 carries from Chase Brown, and Joe Burrow was sacked 3 times.
stories.hero_stat: 31 rushing yards allowed, fewest this season; previous low 44

stories.title: Antonio Williams caught 9 passes for 122 yards, both season highs
stories.dek: The 122 yards nearly doubled his previous best of 64, in Washington's 22-20 win over Cincinnati.
stories.hook: Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high-pressure' situation for Commanders
stories.hero_stat: 122 yards on 9 catches, both season highs; previous bests 5 catches, 64 yards

stories.title: The 49ers are 9-1 for the first time since 2019
stories.dek: Brock Purdy went 21-of-26 for 255 yards and 3 touchdowns in Mexico City, and Minnesota scored nothing in the second half.

stories.title: Prescott went 28-of-33 as the Cowboys scored a season-high 51 points
stories.dek: CeeDee Lamb caught 11 passes for 132 yards and George Pickens added 102, the first game this season with 2 Dallas 100-yard receivers.
stories.hero_stat: 51 points, a season high; Prescott 28-of-33 with 4 touchdowns

stories.title: The Colts scored 3 points, their fewest in a game since December 2022
stories.dek: Indianapolis managed 167 yards and 8 first downs in a 26-3 loss at Houston on Thursday.
stories.hero_stat: 3 points, the Colts' fewest since December 2022

stories.title: The Chargers won their first game after an 0-8 start, a first since 2013
stories.dek: Los Angeles beat Baltimore 23-20 on Monday, and only 6 of the 18 teams to start 0-8 since 1999 won their 9th game.
stories.hero_stat: 1-8 after the first win, the 6th 0-8 team since 1999 to win its 9th game

stories.title: Dallas scored 40 points and still lost to San Francisco
stories.dek: The 46-40 game was only the 26th time since 1999 that a team scored 40 points and lost.
stories.hero_stat: 40 points scored in a loss — 26th time since 1999

stories.title: Buffalo is 8-1 for the first time since 1999
stories.dek: The Bills beat the Jets 31-12 and have scored 287 points, the most in the NFL.

stories.title: The Vikings are 7-2 while scoring 176 points, the 4th-fewest since 1999
stories.dek: Minnesota has allowed 126 points, the fewest in the NFL, and its 30-10 win at Green Bay was its largest there since 1999.
stories.hero_stat: 176 points scored in 9 games — 4th-fewest by a 7-2 team since 1999accent: #4f2683

stories.title: Tampa Bay's plus-24 differential is the best for a 3-6 team since 1999
stories.dek: The Buccaneers are 3-6 through 9 games despite outscoring opponents 202-178; since 1999, no team that went 3-6 through 9 games has had a better differential.
stories.hero_stat: plus-24 differential at 3-6, the best for a 3-6 team since 1999

stories.title: The Patriots are 6-0 in games after a loss under Mike Vrabel
stories.dek: New England has won all 6 games following a loss since Vrabel took over in the 2025 season, while the league wins 45.4% of games after a loss since 1999.
stories.hook: Patriots are 6-0 after a regular-season loss under Vrabel: Can they do it again?
stories.hero_stat: 6-0 in games after a loss under Vrabel

stories.title: All 4 NFC North teams are 6-2 or better through Week 9, a first since 1999
stories.dek: Chicago leads the division at 7-2 despite losing both of its division games.
stories.hook: "NFC North: Bears win division? Cousins has Vikes in command?"
stories.hero_stat: 4 teams at 6-2 or better, first since 1999

stories.title: Kirk Cousins has 20 touchdown passes; Minnesota's quarterbacks have 8
stories.dek: Cousins ranks 2nd in the NFL in touchdown passes, and his 20 are more than the 12 touchdowns Minnesota has scored in total.

stories.title: The 7-2 Broncos are plus-12, one of 3 such starts since 1999
stories.dek: Denver has won 6 of its 7 games by 7 points or fewer, while its 2 losses came by 31 points combined.

stories.title: The Eagles are 2-7, the 6th team since 1999 to lose 7 straight after 2-0
stories.dek: Philadelphia has scored 100 points in the 7 losses, 14.3 a game, and none of the previous 5 teams finished with more than 5 wins.

stories.title: The Jaguars are plus-108 through 8 games, one of 26 such starts since 1999
stories.dek: Only 25 other teams since 1999 reached plus-108 through 8 games, and the last Jaguars team to do it finished 14-2.

stories.title: The Chargers are 0-7, the NFL's only winless team
stories.dek: Los Angeles has scored 99 points and allowed 175 through Sunday's Week 8 games, a minus-76 differential that is also the league's worst.

stories.title: The Jaguars have a plus-85 point differential, the best in the NFL
stories.dek: Jacksonville is 5-2 and has outscored opponents 196-111 through Sunday's Week 8 games, leading San Francisco's plus-58 differential by 27.

stories.title: The 49ers have a plus-58 point differential, the best in the NFL
stories.dek: San Francisco is 6-1 and has outscored opponents 197-139, leading Minnesota's plus-51 differential by 7.
stories.hook: Colts trade DeForest Buckner to the 49ers

stories.title: The 2-5 Buccaneers have outscored their opponents, the only 2-5 team to do so
stories.dek: Tampa Bay is plus-11 on the season, because all 5 of its losses came by 7 or fewer points.
stories.hero_stat: 2-5 record with a plus-11 point differential

stories.title: The Cardinals have allowed 208 points through Week 7, the most in the NFL
stories.dek: Arizona allows 29.7 points per game, and has given up 30 or more in 5 of its 7 games.

stories.title: The 6-0 Vikings are the NFL's only unbeaten team, scoring 20.8 a game
stories.dek: Minnesota scores 20.8 points per game and allows 12.3, against a league average of 23.2.

stories.title: The Titans have scored 58 points through Week 5, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Tennessee is 0-5, but its defense has allowed 109 points, tied for 10th-fewest — the offense is scoring at half the league rate.

stories.title: The Jaguars have allowed 36 points through Week 3, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Jacksonville is 2-1, and its +46 point differential trails only unbeaten San Francisco's.
